workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: wandb-core grows ~2.5 MiB per wandb.Api() instance and never frees it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): stop wandb-core from leaking memory for every wandb.Api() instance. Target files: core/internal/wbapi/wbapi.go, core/pkg/server/connection.go, CHANGELOG.unreleased.md. Description ----------- - Every `wandb.Api()` registers an API session in wandb-core. The connection built an OpenTelemetry proxy for the session's logger and parked a goroutine on the connection context to shut it down, so the proxy and its preallocated log queue outlived the session's `api_cleanup_request` and stayed around until the connection closed... (Ref: https://github.com/wandb/wandb/pull/12920)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): read projected history with nested columns. Target files: parquet-rust-wrapper/src/lib.rs, parquet-rust-wrapper/tests/lib_tests.rs, CHANGELOG.unreleased.md. Description ----------- - (Ref: https://github.com/wandb/wandb/pull/12542)

Fix: fix(sweeps): make sweeps agent support saving json output to custom `WANDB_DIR`. Target files: wandb/wandb_agent.py, tests/unit_tests/test_wandb_agent/test_cli_agent.py, CHANGELOG.unreleased.md. Description ----------- - Fixes https://github.com/wandb/wandb/issues/8577 Ensure that Sweeps agent saves JSON output to a custom `WANDB_DIR` if set. Adapted from @MissEntropy's PR: - #8713 but putting a unit test in the correct location. (That PR conflated sweep agent and launch agent.) (Ref: https://github.com/wandb/wandb/pull/12344)
